audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows disagreed with the packet, with the page's own whys, and with the already-audited mirror — including giving Shen levels 2 and 3 while whys[1] and whys[2] describe Fiora winning both.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things were absent: the vitals were attributed to Grand Challenge rather than the passive, and nothing said what Riposte does to Stand United.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance (P) is what reveals the lane vital; Grand Challenge (R) reveals all four at once. Riposte parries all incoming damage and, because Shadow Dash is an immobilizing effect, the return stab stuns instead of slows — and that stun cancels Stand United's channel, stranding the ally you were saving. Riposte's default return is only a slow, which is not an interrupt, so the line is written as 'a Riposte stun', matching the mirror.
audit.corrected: Named in report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d, phases[1].why, whys[0], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds anywhere in the content layer despite two healing sources.
audit.why: missingInteractions 'needs-antiheal': Duelist's Dance heals on every vital and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies on a completed proc, so armour alone reads the extended trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal folded into the first-item spike where the reader picks the build.

edits.before: Fiora owns levels 1 through 3 cleanly. Her passive Grand Challenge spawns vitals on your flanks and back — vital procs deal percent-max-HP true damage that your tankiness cannot mitigate, and she can weave a Lunge in and out to reach them before your W zone covers enough ground. Do not stand still: keep moving so she cannot spawn a vital on a predictable side. At level 2, if you try to E-taunt she will Riposte the dash on reaction and stun you, turning your engage into a full trade loss. The play is to respect these levels completely — last-hit with Q empowered autos from range, bait Riposte with a step-in that you cancel, and only commit Shadow Dash when you have confirmed Riposte is on cooldown. At level 3 she still wins the extended duel; take the short trade with E-Q-passive shield and get out before she can stack a second vital.
edits.after: Fiora owns levels 1 through 3 cleanly. Her passive Duelist's Dance spawns vitals on your flanks and back — vital procs deal percent-max-HP true damage that your tankiness cannot mitigate, and she can weave a Lunge in and out to reach them before your W zone covers enough ground. Do not stand still: keep moving so she cannot spawn a vital on a predictable side. At level 2, if you try to E-taunt she will Riposte the dash on reaction and stun you, turning your engage into a full trade loss. The play is to respect these levels completely — last-hit with Q empowered autos from range, bait Riposte with a step-in that you cancel, and only commit Shadow Dash when you have confirmed Riposte is on cooldown.
